summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals, including file-level access delegation in the REST Catalog spec and the integration of EagerInputFile into the manifest reader for performance improvements. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about migrating to Jackson 3 and enabling GitHub Copilot for code reviews.
highlights: Proposal for file-level access delegation in REST Catalog spec
Integration of EagerInputFile into the v4 manifest reader
Discussion on migrating Iceberg to Jackson 3
Enabling GitHub Copilot for code reviews in Iceberg repositories
